about: Commit da5cf6a, "Updating the proposed file structure.": one new file whose single hunk, about 5,400 characters of code, is over the change-summary character budget, and one deleted file. Planted mistake 2 sits in the part of that hunk past the budget.

true_document.summary: Replaces proposed_structure.txt, the tree of the earlier kev_auditor/ layout, with proposed_structure.md: a refactoring plan for the domain models, units, extractors and a QuestionType enum, and the proposed src/ structure with each file's status.

files.summary: Adds proposed_structure.md: a plan to split models.py into small domain modules, make AuditableUnit an ABC with get_content(), plan two tiers of extractors under BaseUnitExtractor and add a QuestionType enum; and the proposed src/ structure, marking each file unchanged, new, reworked, updated or planned.

hunks.summary: Adds proposed_structure.md, with a Plan and a Proposed structure section. The plan splits src/core/domain/models.py into rule.py, report.py and a units/ subpackage, each file well under 100 lines; makes AuditableUnit a pure ABC that requires unit_id, unit_type and an abstract get_content(), moving the file fields to AuditableFileUnit, with composite units building get_content() from their children; keeps BaseUnitExtractor and WholeFileExtractor as the only active extractors, with a project structure tier and a code component tier planned under BaseUnitExtractor; and adds a QuestionType enum for AuditRule and JsonRuleLoader. The proposed structure lists each file under src/, from cli/ to rules/json_loader.py, as unchanged, new, reworked, updated (imports) or planned.

files.summary: Deletes proposed_structure.txt, the tree of the earlier kev_auditor/ layout.
